Theme

Latin word

caelum

caelum, caelī n.

noun, second declension

the climate of a place; its sky and weather; heaven; sky, heaven; the weather; the state of the sky

In this lexicon

  • climate

    the recommended word · classical · Liv. 5.54.3: hoc caelum, sub quō nātus ēducātusque essem (Lewis & Short); Hor. Ep. 1.11.27; Traupman 135, 292; Traupman 203

  • heaven

    the recommended word · classical · Vulg. Mt. 6.9; M-O s.v. heaven

  • sky

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Tusc. 1.43: caelum hoc, in quō nūbēs, imbrēs, ventīque cōguntur; Cic. ND 2.4: cum caelum suspeximus; Traupman 136

  • weather

    also used · classical · Plin. Ep. 8.17.1: immīte et turbidum caelum; Col. 12.47.2: serēnō caelō; Traupman 292; Traupman 135, 405

  • digitō caelum attingere: be in seventh heaven

    classical

  • caelum crassum: sultry

    classical
